theorems.name: Submission.cmr_abs_apply_le_massOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n) (r : ℝ), T.massOn W ≠ ∞ → tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ W → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ≤ r) → |T ω| ≤ r * (T.massOn W).toReal
